units.title: Clay Modelling & Hand building Techniques
topics: 1. Clay Preparation & Modelling Methods  Types of clay for modelling  Wedging and kneading  Moisture control and workability
1.2. Hand building Techniques  Pinching method  Coil building  Slab building
1.3. Creating Basic Clay Models  Making simple geometric forms  Joining techniques & slip preparation  Finishing and smoothing of models

units.title: Decorative Arts & Surface Enhancements
topics: 2.1. Decorative Techniques  Engobes and slips  Incising, carving, stamping  Sgraffito technique
2.2. Surface Texturing & Pattern Making  Natural texture impressions  Fabric, tool, and object-based textures  Repeating pattern creation
2.3. Coloring & Glaze Decoration  Underglaze decoration methods  Brush, sponge, spray techniques  Basic glaze application & firing behaviour

units.title: Digital Designing for Ceramics
topics: 3.1. Introduction to Ceramic Design Software  Basics of 2D design tools (AutoCAD, photoshop or any other relevant free software available)  File formats & resolution  Layers, shapes, and tool functions
3.2. Digital Pattern Development  Creating motifs for ceramic wares  Color palette selection  Repeat pattern generation
3.3. 3D Visualisation in Ceramics  Introduction to simple 3D tools (SketchUp/Blender basics)  Creating basic 3D ceramic forms  Rendering textures & colours

units.title: Product Design – Crockery, Sanitary Ware & Tiles
topics: 4.1. Crockery Design (Cup, Saucer, Plates)  Shape development & ergonomics  Model and mould considerations  Aesthetic & functional design
4.2. Sanitary Ware Forms  Design principles of washbasins & toilet ware  Curves, contours & volume  Strength and glaze considerations
4.3. Ceramic Tile Design  Tile sizes, layout & proportions  Surface patterns, textures & themes  Digital tile mock-ups for wall & floor
